## Activity

During February 2022, Hill Counties Health Centre completed 41 captures as part of routine site activity. This provides the basis for reviewing the volume of work undertaken during the month and the subsequent grading outcomes. The activity level should continue to be monitored alongside image quality and reporting times so that operational issues can be identified and addressed promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 41 captures, 2 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.9. This indicates that most images were suitable for review, while the ungradable cases should be considered when checking equipment, image-taking practice, and local working arrangements. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead, to support investigation and follow-up.

## Grading

A total of 6 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 15. These findings should be reviewed with the site’s activity and image-quality information to support ongoing service oversight. Continued attention to camera performance and the timely logging of faults will help maintain reliable capture quality and support the grading process.
